items.title: Google將AI Mode廣告擴展至新加坡等十個市場

items.summary_en: Google announced on October 28 that AI Mode ads are expanding to ten markets, including Singapore, Malaysia, India and Australia. Multiturn ads are launching in the US.

items.next_step: 先向Google帳戶團隊確認適用活動及推出進度，再檢視產品資料與落地頁是否回答較長的比較問題。
items.next_step_en: Confirm eligible campaigns and rollout with Google, then review whether product feeds and landing pages answer detailed comparison questions.
highlights: 其餘市場為加拿大、肯尼亞、新西蘭、尼日利亞、巴基斯坦及菲律賓。
巴西、墨西哥及英國列入2026年第四季擴展計劃；廣告標示為Sponsored。
highlights_en: The other markets are Canada, Kenya, New Zealand, Nigeria, Pakistan and the Philippines.

items.detail:
Google於10月28日宣布，AI Mode廣告正擴展至十個市場，包括新加坡、馬來西亞、印度及澳洲；美國同時推出可出現在追問中的multiturn ads。

其餘市場為加拿大、肯尼亞、新西蘭、尼日利亞、巴基斯坦及菲律賓。

巴西、墨西哥及英國列入2026年第四季擴展計劃；廣告標示為Sponsored。

面向東南亞的品牌可把AI對話搜尋納入媒體檢視，並逐市場確認實際展示及可取得的報表。

先向Google帳戶團隊確認適用活動及推出進度，再檢視產品資料與落地頁是否回答較長的比較問題。

公告未列香港；美國追問廣告不等同已擴展至所有市場。點擊率比較屬Google內部資料，本刊不作獨立成效結論。
items.detail_en:
Google announced on October 28 that AI Mode ads are expanding to ten markets, including Singapore, Malaysia, India and Australia. Multiturn ads are launching in the US.

The other markets are Canada, Kenya, New Zealand, Nigeria, Pakistan and the Philippines.

Brazil, Mexico and the UK are planned for Q4 2026; ads carry a Sponsored label.

Brands serving Southeast Asia can review conversational search within their media plans and confirm market-level delivery and reporting.

Confirm eligible campaigns and rollout with Google, then review whether product feeds and landing pages answer detailed comparison questions.

Hong Kong is not listed. US multiturn ads are distinct from the international rollout; internal click-rate comparisons are not independently validated.

items.title: OpenAI重整Model Spec，明示人類意圖、透明度與代理行動原則

items.summary: OpenAI於10月29日更新公開Model Spec，將模型行為指引按五項價值重整，並增加情境、監督及人的自主性相關指引。
items.summary_en: OpenAI updated its public Model Spec on October 29, organizing behavior guidance around five values and adding guidance on context, oversight and human agency.
items.why: 使用AI代理的行銷團隊可把透明度、授權範圍及副作用提示轉成實際驗收案例。

highlights: 五項價值涵蓋忠於人類意圖、減少傷害、誠實透明、人的自主性及關懷。

highlights_en: The values cover faithfulness to human intent, harm minimization, honesty and transparency, human agency, and care.

五項價值涵蓋忠於人類意圖、減少傷害、誠實透明、人的自主性及關懷。

items.detail_en:
OpenAI updated its public Model Spec on October 29, organizing behavior guidance around five values and adding guidance on context, oversight and human agency.

The values cover faithfulness to human intent, harm minimization, honesty and transparency, human agency, and care.

The revision expands side-effect guidance and retires much detailed style advice; OpenAI says models do not yet fully reflect the Spec.
